He is currently serving 15 consecutive life sentences at ADX Florence, a federal supermax prison near Florence, Colorado.
Breach (film) | Breach is a 2007 American historical and political thriller film directed by Billy Ray. After appearing as Billy Douglas on the soap opera "One Life to Live", he came to fame in the late 1990s with starring roles in a string of films, including "I Know What You Did Last Summer", "Cruel Intentions", and "54".  In the 2000s, he appeared in several films, including "Gosford Park" (2001), "Crash" (2004), and war drama "Flags of Our Fathers" (2006), "Breach" (2007), and "Stop-Loss" (2008). Donnie R. Marshall | Donnie R. Marshall was the first career Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) special agent to rise through the ranks to become Administrator of DEA.
